camel_example: aliyun ims UpdateAccessKey --region cn-hangzhou --Status Active --UserAccessKeyId LTAI0000000000000000000
description_en: Modifies the status of an AccessKey pair for an Alibaba Cloud account or a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 修改阿里云账号（主账号）或RAM用户的访问密钥状态
kebab_example: aliyun ims update-access-key --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAccessKey

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If this parameter is empty, the status of the AccessKey pair for the current user is modified
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

如果为空，默认修改当前用户的访问密钥
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for which you want to modify the status
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改状态的访问密钥ID
parameters.name: user_access_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the AccessKey pair. Valid values:

Active

Inactive
parameters.help_zh:
访问密钥的状态。取值：

Active：已激活。
Inactive：已禁用
parameters.name: status
